warnings.description: Composite contract locators (e.g., '7. ОТВЕТСТВЕННОСТЬ сторон, п. 0.1') are used in links and atomic_links instead of bare printed sub-clause numbers (e.g., '0.1'). The SKILL.md requires exact printed locators from contract.txt. The bare '0.1' IS the printed locator; the composite form adds the section heading for disambiguation but is not verbatim from the contract. The contract_inventory uses bare locators, creating a mismatch.
warnings.recommendation: Either (a) update contract_inventory to include composite locators as aliases, or (b) change links/atomic_links to use bare printed locators and add a 'contract_section' field for disambiguation. The composite form is functionally clear but violates the strict 'exact printed locator' rule.

warnings.description: Material contract inventory items (bare '0.X' sub-clauses) are not directly referenced in links or unmatched_contract. They are covered via composite locators in links. This is a consequence of the locator format mismatch described above.
warnings.recommendation: Resolved automatically if the locator format issue is fixed.
